name: Palm Grove Society
homesLabel: 180 homes · residents only beyond this page
description: A private, gated residential community. Anyone can look around here — the directory, messaging and classifieds inside are for residents.
exploreDescription: A gated community with gardens, a clubhouse and quiet streets.

amenities.name: Garden

amenities.name: Clubhouse
amenities.blurb: A shared hall for gatherings, celebrations and monthly meetings.

garden.title: The Garden
garden.description: Landscaped gardens with walking paths and seating, tended year-round by the community's gardening team.
garden.footer: Open to all residents; guests should be accompanied.

clubhouse.title: The Clubhouse
clubhouse.description: A shared hall for community gatherings, celebrations, and the monthly residents' meeting.
clubhouse.footer: Bookings are managed through the residents' association.

security.title: Security
security.description: Round-the-clock security staff, CCTV coverage at all entry points, and a single gated entrance for the whole community.
security.footer: All visitors and deliveries are logged at the gate.

playarea.title: Kids' Play Area
playarea.description: A safe, fenced play area with swings, a slide and soft flooring, for younger residents.
playarea.footer: Children should be accompanied by an adult at all times.

classifieds.title: Yoga mats (set of 2), barely used
classifieds.description: Two yoga mats, 6mm thick, used for about two months. No tears or heavy wear. Selling both together as we're switching to a thicker set. Pickup from Unit 12, evenings work best.

classifieds.title: Piano lessons for kids, evenings
classifieds.description: Offering beginner piano lessons for kids aged 6 and up, weekday evenings at my place in Unit 7. Ten years of teaching experience; first lesson is free so you can see if it's a fit.

classifieds.title: Moving sale: dining table + 4 chairs
classifieds.description: Solid wood dining table with 4 matching chairs, good condition, minor scuffs on one leg. We're moving out next week and need it gone quickly — happy to help carry it down.

classifieds.title: Dog walking, weekday mornings
classifieds.description: Retired resident happy to walk your dog weekday mornings while you're at work, usually 7:30–8:30 AM around the community paths. Comfortable with most breeds and sizes.

classifieds.title: Moving boxes, various sizes
classifieds.description: About 15 sturdy moving boxes in various sizes, used once and still in good shape, plus some bubble wrap. Free to whoever can pick them up from Unit 14 this week.
